verdict.rationale: Model selection is a fair question for a coding agent like Jules, so the axis applies. The only model-related evidence is a plan-tier claim of 'priority access to the latest models, starting with Gemini 3 Pro'. That describes access entitlements, not a documented control for switching from automatic selection to a user-chosen model, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can switch away from automatic model selection to a specific model of my choice
